pumi.harness.v1.Line.jsonschema.json.description:
Line is one line of the adapter's standard output (decisions 0241 and
 0252). The adapter may write any number of usage figures, each as soon as
 its harness reports it, and then exactly one result, which is the last
 line. A line that does not parse, a line with neither, a line after the
 result and a missing result fail the invocation.

usage.description:
The usage of one model call, or of one turn for a harness that
 reports usage per turn, as the harness reported it.

pumi.harness.v1.Line.jsonschema.json.title: Line

pumi.harness.v1.Refusal.jsonschema.json.description:
Refusal is one thing that the run asked to do and its harness refused
 (decision 0249).

command.description: The command that the run asked to run, as the harness reported it.

host.description: The host that the run asked to reach.

path.description:
The path, relative to the workspace or absolute, that the run asked
 to read or write.

tool.description: The kind of tool that asked.
tool.title: Tool Kind

pumi.harness.v1.Refusal.jsonschema.json.title: Refusal

pumi.harness.v1.Result.jsonschema.json.description:
Result is what a harness adapter writes to its standard output when it
 exits (decisions 0158 and 0160). Exit status 0 means a result was
 written. A non-zero exit status, a missing result or a result that does
 not parse fails the invocation.

^(output_files)$.description:
The paths of the output files, relative to the workspace. The runner
 uploads them to the blob store and records them by hash (decision
 0033).

output.description:
The structured output, as JSON of the message named in the invocation's
 output schema.

outputFiles.description:
The paths of the output files, relative to the workspace. The runner
 uploads them to the blob store and records them by hash (decision
 0033).

refusals.description:
The refusals that the harness reported: what the run asked to do that
 its settings refused. The runner puts them in invocation.result, and
 the question of an escalation names them. An adapter reports what its
 harness tells it, so a harness that reports no refusals gives none
 (decision 0249).

usage.description:
The adapter's own usage figures, for information only. The runner
 writes them to the invocation's log; the usage of invocation.result is
 the model gateway's totals with the wall time the runner measured
 (decision 0230).

pumi.harness.v1.Result.jsonschema.json.title: Result

pumi.harness.v1.Usage.jsonschema.json.description:
Usage is an amount of usage: of a budget, or what a run used (decision
 0136).
pumi.harness.v1.Usage.jsonschema.json.title: Usage

pumi.harness.v1.UsageFigure.jsonschema.j.description:
UsageFigure is the usage that the harness reported for one model call,
 or for one turn, with every kind of token that the list-price table
 prices (decisions 0239 and 0241). On the sign-in path the runner counts
 these figures; on the gateway path it writes them to the invocation's
 log, and the gateway's count is the one that counts (decision 0230).

^(cache_read_tokens)$.description: The tokens read from the cache.

^(five_minute_cache_write_tokens)$.description:
The tokens written to the 5-minute cache. A cache write that the
 harness does not split by duration is a 5-minute write.

^(inference_geo)$.description:
The inference geography of the call as the provider reported it, such
 as "us"; empty when not reported.

^(input_tokens)$.description:
The input tokens that were not read from or written to the prompt
 cache.

^(one_hour_cache_write_tokens)$.description: The tokens written to the 1-hour cache.

^(output_tokens)$.description: The output tokens, thinking and reasoning included.

^(web_searches)$.description: The number of web searches that the call made.

cacheReadTokens.description: The tokens read from the cache.

fiveMinuteCacheWriteTokens.description:
The tokens written to the 5-minute cache. A cache write that the

inferenceGeo.description:
The inference geography of the call as the provider reported it, such

inputTokens.description:
The input tokens that were not read from or written to the prompt
 cache.

model.description: The model that answered, as the harness reported it.

oneHourCacheWriteTokens.description: The tokens written to the 1-hour cache.

outputTokens.description: The output tokens, thinking and reasoning included.

speed.description:
The speed of the call as the provider reported it, such as "fast";
 empty when not reported.

webSearches.description: The number of web searches that the call made.
